gloss: to rustle; to murmur; to buzz

definitions.gloss: to rustle; to murmur; to buzz
definitions.explanation: to produce a continuous low sound of many voices or the rustling of leaves

examples.japanese: {木|き}の{葉|は}がざわめいている。
{教室|きょうしつ}がざわめいていた。
examples.english: The classroom was buzzing with noise.

examples.japanese: {噂|うわさ}を{聞|き}いて{街|まち}がざわめいた。
examples.english: The town buzzed when it heard the rumor.

notes:
ざわめく describes continuous low-level noise, either from nature (leaves) or people (murmuring).

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (く-verb)
- Intransitive

ONOMATOPOEIC ORIGIN:
- From ざわざわ (rustling/murmuring sound)
- The ～めく suffix creates verbs from onomatopoeia

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木|き}の{葉|は}がざわめく (leaves rustle)
- {森|もり}がざわめく (forest rustles)
- {教室|きょうしつ}がざわめく (classroom buzzes)
- {街|まち}がざわめく (town buzzes)
- {胸|むね}がざわめく (heart stirs with unease)

FIGURATIVE USE:
- {胸|むね}がざわめく describes inner unease
- {心|こころ}がざわめく similar emotional stirring

COMPARISON WITH どよめく:
- ざわめく: Continuous, lower intensity, background noise
- どよめく: Sudden, louder, collective reaction to an event

RELATED WORDS:
- ざわざわ (onomatopoeia: rustling)
- ざわつく (to be restless/noisy)
- {騒|さわ}がしい (noisy)

REGISTER: Neutral to literary. Common in both conversation and writing.
